title: SF3131 (2017-2018 Regular): Slide-fire stock for a semiautomatic firearm is a trigger activator clarification

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/90/2018/0/SF/3131/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version as filed (SF 3131, 2017-2018 session). Text shows no struck words. The bill only changes a definition; the existing offences for trigger activators sit elsewhere in 609.67.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.67, subd. 1): "Trigger activator" means a removable manual or power driven trigger activating device constructed and designed so that, when attached to a firearm, the rate at which the trigger may be pulled increases and the rate of fire of the firearm increases to approximate that of a machine gun. For purposes of this section, a device that is designed to use the recoil of a semiautomatic firearm to enable a shooter to fire multiple shots in rapid succession, commonly known as a slide-fire or bump-fire stock, is a trigger activator.
